newsitem.title: USA: Bristol names head of drug research unit.
newsitem.headline: Bristol names head of drug research unit.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said on Thursday that it hired Peter Ringrose, a former Pfizer Inc executive, as president of its Pharmaceutical Research Institute, effective in January.
The company said the move was part of Rosenberg's plan to retire in early 1998. Until then, Rosenberg will serve as senior vice president for scientific affairs for Bristol-Myers, the company said.
At Pfizer, Ringrose was senior vice president of Worldwide Discovery and Medicinal Research and Development, Europe.
In his new post Ringrose will report to Kenneth Weg, president, Bristol-Myers Squibb Pharmaceutical Group.

Bristol-Myers said it expects to spend over $1 billion on pharmaceutical research in 1996, supporting 42 compounds in active development. The institute includes about 3,600 scientific and support staff.
